---
title: "Fire Incident Data"
subtitle: "In Progress"
---

An incident-level analysis of El Cerrito fire and EMS calls, following
the same methodology as the [police incident analysis](police.qmd) --
data verification, geocoding, geographic and time-trend analysis, and
response times -- is planned but not yet complete.

This page will be updated once that analysis is available. In the
meantime, see the [Public Safety](../public-safety/fire/index.qmd)
section for fire department organization, staffing, and budget
information.
